text:
molly: Heads-up — launching our CloudAxis marketplace integration next week. Need a compact partner SEV path: shared channel, auto-warroom, and SI handoff checklist. Can we sync today? :eyes:

raj: Available 3pm PT. Quick Q: who should be allowed to trigger the joint bridge — partner users or only Redwood oncall?

emily: Support rec: partners should be able to open a ticket in #partner-hotline but escalation to joint war room requires an oncall ack or a 10m timer. Also we need a read-only log stream accessible to partner SIs.

kevin: I can wire an automation. Proposal: partner pings our webhook `/sev/partner` with a signed payload; deploy-bot creates the warroom + call link. Example payload snippet:
```
{
  "trigger": "partner_sev",
  "source": "cloudaxis",
  "severity": 1
}
```
This creates `#joint-warroom-<shortid>` and tags the oncall rota.

molly: That sounds good. Raj, can you draft the runbook steps for the bridge owner? Keep it minimal: who creates, who pings partner, fallback to vendor oncall.

raj: Will do. Draft now:
1) partner posts to #partner-hotline with incident_id and logs link
2) if no ack in 10m -> escalate to #joint-warroom and notify oncall
3) bridge owner posts current perf snapshot + short summary and tags @molly @kevin @emily
4) if HW is implicated, ping vendor-oncall and attach HW diagnostics

partner-bot: Automated warroom template `joint-warroom-template-v2` available. Command: `/warroom create --template joint-warroom-template-v2 --partner cloudaxis`

emily: For SI handoff add a mandatory checklist in the warroom doc: env, exact repro steps, minimal dump, timeline, and data-sharing consent checkbox. This avoids back-and-forth.

kevin: I'll add automation to attach the model-serving perf dashboard and last-1h KV-cache dump when the warroom is created. Also enable a light-weight redaction tool for any sensitive logs before sharing.

molly: Excellent. Action items: raj — runbook draft by EOD; kevin — warroom automation + dashboard attachment; emily — SI handoff checklist template. We'll run a 15min drill tomorrow 10am PT to validate.

raj: On it, will post the draft here in ~30m.

emily: +1 to drill :muscle:

kevin: +1
